efa0a118-ea1c-4b0d-9247-4a8836e243ba.name: carrysave
efa0a118-ea1c-4b0d-9247-4a8836e243ba.result: PROVED. Unbounded x+y+z = (x^^^y^^^z)+2*maj x y z over all of ℕ; the 2^n bound was not needed. Axioms clean.

6d4c39e6-1d25-4896-86ee-a3ffcf0a4410.name: rangefloor
6d4c39e6-1d25-4896-86ee-a3ffcf0a4410.result: SETTLED. 2n-1 achievable everywhere (ALREADY LIVE in our RangeCheck.main); exact optimum 3 at n=2; floor >=4 for n>=3; one witness certifies at most 2 bits. n>=3 exact optimum left open.

b66d5009-41a7-4f84-a6a7-a1818c0e7018.name: switch1row
b66d5009-41a7-4f84-a6a7-a1818c0e7018.result: PROVED, AND MORE THAN ASKED. One-row switch iff, plus full permutation networks with UNCONDITIONAL multiset soundness (no random challenge) and completeness.

38d84ac1-b470-412d-a8dc-0c2285c802ea.name: bilinearrank
38d84ac1-b470-412d-a8dc-0c2285c802ea.result: SETTLED AS AN INEQUALITY. minRows <= tensorRank (savings transfer); tensorRank <= 9*minRows^2 (converse only quadratic, so rank lower bounds do NOT give row lower bounds); one row buys exactly rank one.
